sources.entry: LibreBooking - Resource scheduling solution offering a flexible, mobile-friendly, and extensible interface for organizations to manage resource reservations. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: LibreBooking is an open-source, self-hostable resource scheduling application for organizations to manage and reserve shared resources, forked from Booked Scheduler.
summary.what_it_does: LibreBooking provides a web interface for booking and managing resource reservations, with multi-resource booking and waitlists. It supports role-based access control, quotas and credits for reservations, and granular usage reporting. The interface is responsive Bootstrap 5 with DataTables listings, and themes and color schemes can be selected in config.php or customized through a CSS file. It offers ics calendar integration for Outlook and Thunderbird, and the README mentions OAuth2 and SAML configuration docs plus an API. The README also says the codebase is plugin-ready.
use_cases: manage resource reservations for an organization
sync reservations to Outlook or Thunderbird via ics
how_to_run: git clone the repository (URL not captured in README)
Manual install: prepare PHP >= 8.2 with listed extensions, Apache >= 2.4, MySQL >= 8.0 or MariaDB >= 10.6, and Composer, then follow the INSTALLATION guide
notable: Forked from Booked Scheduler, based on its last open-source 2020 release
Plugin-ready architecture with OAuth2 and SAML configuration docs
Multiple built-in CSS themes selectable in config.php
Public demo instance that resets every 20 minutes
caveats: README carries a critical security warning: all versions before 7.1.0 are vulnerable to forged 'Remember Me' cookies, and older versions receive no backported fixes; upgrade to 7.1.0 or later
Only Apache is officially supported; Nginx may work but is untested by the project
